phases.scope: 确认 Sub2 API、卡字段、邮箱供应商、角色和部署环境
phases.acceptance_criterion: 形成接口样例、数据分类、合规边界和不可变更项
target_evidence_required: approved data classification and immutable-boundary record
missing_inputs: redacted Sub2 authentication, four-stage workflow, request/response shape, idempotency scope/retention and status-consistency samples
redacted mail-provider request, response, authentication and rate-limit samples
card PAN/CVV field inventory and PCI scope decision
Keycloak ACR-to-LoA mapping and production deployment identity

phases.acceptance_criterion: 能登录、鉴权、审计、生成 OpenAPI 和前端客户端
target_evidence_required: target Keycloak and Vault login, authorization, audit and administrator-separation evidence
target PostgreSQL, Redis, TLS, secret-manager, backup and CI release evidence

phases.scope: 任务、邮箱连接器、mail session、验证码 API
phases.acceptance_criterion: EXE 能登录并只通过 session 获取验证码；原始凭据不出服务端
target_evidence_required: real mail-provider concurrency, outage, rate-limit and stale-code evidence
missing_inputs: real mail-provider interface and policy samples

phases.scope: 卡池、分配、租约、掩码和一次性揭示
phases.acceptance_criterion: 并发分配无重复；用户无法越权；完整动作有审计
target_evidence_required: target PostgreSQL concurrent-allocation and migration evidence
target Keycloak step-up and PCI scope evidence
missing_inputs: card PAN/CVV and PCI compliance boundary decision
approved Card Vault secure-import receipt contract and repository verifier/consumer implementation

phases.scope: Sub2 Adapter、策略、幂等、未知结果核对
phases.acceptance_criterion: 客户端无 Sub2 配置；成功/失败/未知可区分和回放
target_evidence_required: real Sub2 balance-check, authorization-exchange, create success/failure/timeout, five status outcomes, same-key replay and unknown-reconciliation evidence
target Vault-path denial and domain egress-policy evidence
missing_inputs: real Sub2 balance-check, authorization-exchange, create and status-query mappings with idempotency scope/retention and consistency semantics

phases.scope: EXE 登录改造、平台任务工作台、自动填充适配
phases.acceptance_criterion: 现有连续复制/粘贴体验保留，注销/过期可安全停止
target_evidence_required: Windows EXE login, lock, logout, offline recovery, update rollback and clipboard evidence
real business-page field-order and continuous-paste evidence
missing_inputs: approved real business-page field sequence and Windows pilot environment

phases.scope: 小范围试点、监控、培训、回滚演练
phases.acceptance_criterion: 试点用户全流程完成；无越权、无敏感日志、可追溯
target_evidence_required: real pilot-user end-to-end evidence and independent review
real alert delivery, backup restore, rollback, training and audit-trace evidence
non-production IAM and storage denial, data provenance, fixture digest, live connector and mailbox-secret absence, and independent review evidence
missing_inputs: pilot users, target operators, alert receivers and approved maintenance window
target development and demo data-provenance and access-control evidence
